```sql
SELECT u.DisplayName, u.Location
FROM main.posts p
JOIN main.posts a ON p.AcceptedAnswerId = a.Id
JOIN main.users u ON a.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.PostTypeId = 1
  AND a.PostTypeId = 2
  AND a.CreaionDate >= '2013-06-01'
  AND a.CreaionDate < '2013-07-01'
  AND a.CreaionDate <= '2013-08-01'
GROUP BY u.Id, u.DisplayName, u.Location
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 10
```
